knowledge_assets.summary: Elara possesses deep knowledge of the complex algorithms used by the Promise Tax Authority to calculate the tax burden of each promise, including their hidden biases.
Elara has observed various subtle techniques used by citizens to evade promise taxes or hide their true promise obligations.

public_state.main_character_archetype: To uncover a systemic flaw in the Promise Tax Authority's valuation algorithms that disproportionately burdens the innocent, thereby improving 'city_trust_index' and reforming the PTA's 'promise_enforcement_rigor'.
public_state.activity_directive: Actively auditing promise registries to ensure fair taxation and identify discrepancies, aiming to change 'tax_revenue_stability' by increasing collections. Use Debt Collection & Enforcement to push visible consequences and keep the world responsive to players.
